name: Flexport
tagline: Flexport moves freight across ocean, air, and trucking while giving export and logistics teams a single dashboard to track a shipment's exact status instead of chasing updates across carriers. Its AI handles customs paperwork and tariff classification automatically, catching documentation errors before they turn into a hold at the border. Export managers also use its market data to compare landed costs and transit times across different routes before committing to one.
